root.label: Jane Doe lawsuit against Cornell and Chi Pi defendants

events.label: Jane Doe lawsuit against Cornell and Chi Pi defendants

slots.name: accused members
slots.sentence: Jane Doe in her lawsuit accused seven members of the Chi Phi fraternity of sexually assaulting her in 2024.

slots.name: complaint page count
slots.sentence: The 101-page civil complaint names Cornell, fraternity-related entities, seven individual defendants and other defendants.

slots.name: alleged assailant count
slots.sentence: In a new lawsuit filed last month, the woman, identified as Jane Doe, said she was drugged and gang raped by seven men at the Chi Phi fraternity house.

slots.name: victim age
slots.sentence: A former Cornell University student, who identifies by the pseudonym Jane Doe, filed a civil lawsuit in September alleging she was gang-raped at a fraternity in 2024, when she was 20.

slots.name: assault duration
slots.sentence: She said she was drugged and repeatedly raped over the course of seven hours.

slots.name: sued men
slots.sentence: Now, Doe is suing the seven men whom she said perpetrated the assault, and also the university itself, the fraternity and others.

slots.name: lawsuit filing date
slots.sentence: The woman at the centre of the case, identified anonymously as Jane Doe in court documents, filed a civil lawsuit against the Ivy League university in September.

events.label: AOC comments on Cornell sexual assault allegations

slots.name: men alleged count
slots.sentence: "Seven men drugged and gang raped a 20-year-old woman," Ocasio-Cortez said.

slots.name: students expelled
slots.sentence: "Their fraternity knew. This was reported to Cornell University. And after looking into this matter, they expelled two of them and made the rest write essays as their form of punishment," Ocasio-Cortez said.

slots.name: number of perpetrators
slots.sentence: "They lured her in to a fraternity house," she continued. "They drugged her with ketamine. They then posted to a group chat that she was incapacitated, and seven men took turns gang raping her for seven hours."
